extraction.name: ChartQA
extraction.description: A large-scale benchmark for question answering about charts, covering 9.6K human-written questions and 23.1K questions generated from human-written chart summaries. The dataset focuses on complex reasoning questions that involve visual and logical reasoning over real-world charts.
extraction.creator: Ahmed Masry (York University); Do Xuan Long (Nanyang Technological University); Jia Qing Tan (Nanyang Technological University); Shafiq Joty (Nanyang Technological University; Salesforce Research); Enamul Hoque (York University)
extraction.citeAs: Ahmed Masry, Do Xuan Long, Jia Qing Tan, Shafiq Joty, Enamul Hoque. ChartQA: A Benchmark for Question Answering about Charts with Visual and Logical Reasoning. arXiv:2203.10244v1 [cs.CL], 2022.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Charts, data tables, metadata, SVG files, and text descriptions were crawled from four online sources (Statista, Pew Research, OWID, and OECD). Question-answer pairs were subsequently collected by having crowdworkers author them via Amazon Mechanical Turk, and by automatically generating them from human-written chart summaries using a T5 model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: For the Pew dataset, the underlying data tables were not available, so only the chart images were crawled.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Chart images, underlying data tables, metadata (e.g., title, chart type), SVG files, and associated text descriptions from Statista, Pew Research, Our World In Data (OWID), and the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk provided two questions (compositional and visual) with answers for each chart image, and verified two previously asked questions. Workers were selected based on a 95% acceptance rate, 5000 completed HITs, and a pretest.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: If both workers' answers exactly match, the answer is considered correct; otherwise, answers are manually checked to select the final correct answer.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The T5 question generation model may still generate invalid questions because of the mismatch in training and test domains (some questions are either incomplete or not answerable from the chart); Our models can be abused to mislead the public about the charts content and implications, and we can not guarantee that their output will be correct all the time.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Our models can be abused to mislead the public about the charts content and implications.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: To protect the privacy of these annotators, all of their annotations were anonymized.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Data augmentation was performed by fine-tuning a pre-trained T5 model on the SQuAD QA dataset and applying it to human-written chart summaries from Statista to automatically generate questions.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Invalid questions generated by the T5 model were filtered out using a heuristic where a question is removed if the answer cannot be found in the chart data table. Additionally, the test set of the machine-generated dataset was manually cleaned by removing invalid questions.
